text:
Maya Ghosh: Quick check — I'm planning to merge API PR #482 tonight. It introduces a small optional field `meta.v2` in the response. It's backward compatible but SDK needs a tiny shim so Console can read it safely. @Jon can you take a quick look?

Jon McCarthy: On my list, will review in the next hour. Do we have a fallback for clients not sending `meta.v2`?

Maya Ghosh: Yes — server ignores unknown fields; the shim will expose `getMetaV2()` which falls back to `meta.v1`. I'll open the SDK PR and ping reviewers once it's up.

Aleksei Petrov: Heads-up: Console currently pins SDK 1.8.0. If SDK needs a patch we should cut a 1.8.1 and sequence merges. Also ops note: helm needs a sidecar image tag bump for runtime. Filed a ticket in #eng-infra.

Tasha Nguyen: Proposal for merge order: API -> SDK (minor/patch bump) -> Console -> Helm runtime bump. If Jon approves API today I can merge SDK and cut the release.

Jon McCarthy: Left a tiny comment in API PR about streaming client tests — one failing unit. Quick fix is to mock header handling. I can push the fix after lunch and re-run CI.

Maya Ghosh: :thumbsup: added an integration test in the API repo to assert backward compat with old clients.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy: API PR #482 merged to staging at 1836005100. CI status: ✅ green.

Aleksei Petrov: Ran a helm dry-run against staging; runtime sidecar looks compatible but we need the runtime image `build-2026-03-15`. I'll open the chart PR after SDK release is cut.

Aleksei Petrov: shim example:
```
function getMetaV2(obj) {
  return obj.meta?.v2 ?? obj.meta?.v1 ?? null;
}
```

Tasha Nguyen: I'll prepare release notes and changelog. Who's on-call for rollback if prod has issues? @Jon?

Jon McCarthy: I'm available this afternoon and tomorrow AM. Recommend gating prod merge until tomorrow morning to give SRE a window.

Maya Ghosh: Sounds good. I'll queue the SDK PR now and keep Console PR as draft until the SDK tag exists. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
